portal_description:
The FIPSCheck library is used to verify the integrity of modules validated under FIPS-140-2. The fipscheck package provides helper binaries for creating and
verifying HMAC-SHA256 checksum files.

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.4 Release Notes linked from the References section.

Users of fipscheck are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.
